factual_error.projection_limitation: The harness included the observed value but omitted its unit. The real MCP result includes the correct unit. The model inferred L/min, which is incorrect. This is a selection/input limitation plus model inference, not absence of units in the product tool.
factual_error.disposition: Not an unqualified factual user-handoff pass. Preserve the raw answer and require independent assessment; no manual correction or retry.

additional_clarity.note: The heading and other sentences frame the response as past-record interpretation, but this phrase is temporally ambiguous; no operational model call freshly observed sensors.
additional_clarity.ack_translation: ACK(승인) is imprecise; the source is a virtual-device acknowledgement, not an administrator permission grant.

timestamp_roles.fresh: Actual new MCP read completion timestamp in semantics-mcp-capture.json
timestamp_roles.prior: The group tool completion time; setup completed two seconds earlier in the same preserved source capture. Source-level at is not an assertion that both tools completed at exactly that instant.
timestamp_roles.history: The command ACK event time; the original acceptance capture completion time remains at release-acceptance.json /completed_at. These are separate historical records.
